<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$page = wp_insert_post( [ 'post_title' => 'Jobs', 'post_name' => 'jobs', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_content' => '[jobs]' ] );
update_option( 'job_manager_jobs_page_id', $page );

// Pages for the other screens: the Post a Job form and the employer dashboard.
$submit = wp_insert_post( [ 'post_title' => 'Post a Job', 'post_name' => 'post-a-job', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_content' => '[submit_job_form]' ] );
update_option( 'job_manager_submit_job_form_page_id', $submit );
$dash = wp_insert_post( [ 'post_title' => 'Job Dashboard', 'post_name' => 'job-dashboard', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_content' => '[job_dashboard]' ] );
update_option( 'job_manager_job_dashboard_page_id', $dash );

$types = [ 'Full Time', 'Part Time', 'Freelance', 'Internship', 'Temporary' ];
foreach ( $types as $t ) { if ( ! term_exists( $t, 'job_listing_type' ) ) wp_insert_term( $t, 'job_listing_type' ); }
$cats = [ 'Design', 'Engineering', 'Marketing', 'Hospitality' ];
foreach ( $cats as $c ) { if ( ! term_exists( $c, 'job_listing_category' ) ) wp_insert_term( $c, 'job_listing_category' ); }

$jobs = [
	[ 'Senior Product Designer', 'Acme Studio', [ 'Austin', 'TX', '78701' ], 'Full Time', 'Design', 1, 0 ],
	[ 'Barista', 'Bean There', [ 'Portland', 'OR', '97201' ], 'Part Time', 'Hospitality', 0, 0 ],
	[ 'Frontend Engineer', 'Northwind', [], 'Full Time', 'Engineering', 0, 1 ],
	[ 'Content Marketing Freelancer', 'Pixel & Co', [ 'Chicago', 'IL', '60601' ], 'Freelance', 'Marketing', 0, 1 ],
	[ 'Summer Design Intern', 'Acme Studio', [ 'Boston', 'MA', '02108' ], 'Internship', 'Design', 0, 0 ],
	[ 'Seasonal Event Staff', 'Gather', [ 'Denver', 'CO', '80202' ], 'Temporary', 'Hospitality', 0, 0 ],
	[ 'Backend Engineer', 'Northwind', [], 'Full Time', 'Engineering', 1, 1 ],
	[ 'Social Media Manager', 'Pixel & Co', [ 'Brooklyn', 'NY', '11201' ], 'Part Time', 'Marketing', 0, 0 ],
	[ 'UX Researcher', 'Fieldwork', [ 'Seattle', 'WA', '98101' ], 'Full Time', 'Design', 0, 0 ],
	[ 'Line Cook', 'Harbor Kitchen', [ 'Atlanta', 'GA', '30303' ], 'Part Time', 'Hospitality', 0, 0 ],
];

$i = 0;
foreach ( $jobs as $j ) {
	$id = wp_insert_post( [
		'post_title'   => $j[0],
		'post_content' => 'Sample description for ' . $j[0] . '. Replace with real content.',
		'post_type'    => 'job_listing',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_date'    => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - ( $i++ * 86400 * 2 ) ),
		'menu_order'   => $j[5] ? -1 : 0,
	] );
	wp_set_object_terms( $id, $j[3], 'job_listing_type' );
	wp_set_object_terms( $id, $j[4], 'job_listing_category' );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_company_name', $j[1] );
	$city = isset( $j[2][0] ) ? $j[2][0] : '';
	$state = isset( $j[2][1] ) ? $j[2][1] : '';
	$zip = isset( $j[2][2] ) ? $j[2][2] : '';
	update_post_meta( $id, '_job_city', $city );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_job_state', $state );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_job_postcode', $zip );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_wpjm_cs_location_split', 1 );
	// Also stores the full state name, so searching "Texas" works.
	if ( function_exists( 'wpjm_cs_save_combined_location' ) ) {
		wpjm_cs_save_combined_location( $id, $city, $state, $zip );
	}
	// Remote listings leave the location empty, so the plugin shows just "Remote".
	update_post_meta( $id, '_job_location', implode( ', ', array_filter( [ $city, trim( $state . ' ' . $zip ) ] ) ) );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_remote_position', $j[6] );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_featured', $j[5] );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_filled', 0 );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_application', 'jobs@example.com' );
}
